review: Current candidate for owner review. The thumb is bent forward into an opposing hook; its root and inter-link joints now show transverse finger-style barrels in bracket ears, aligned with the finger hinge direction. The four accepted long fingers retain their forms and pose. The larger palm has a broad center plate, recessed structural border and stepped side armor. The thin peg is replaced by a broad faceted wrist drum in a U-shaped support with a short mounting stub. All five digits and the full coupling are visible against white. This is a visual reference; mechanical travel and mesh topology have not been verified.
owner_feedback: Thumb still wrong and bent in a strange way; try another angle and a clear reference of the desired thumb.
